usage: agentware skill sync [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                            [--approve NAME[,NAME...]] [--reject NAME]
                            [--uninstall NAME] [--reset] [--status]
                            [--status-line] [--harness-path HARNESS_PATH]
                            [--force-shadow] [--force-conflict]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --approve NAME[,NAME...]
                        re-vet + install the named quarantined skill(s) into
                        the execution cache (the ONLY install path)
  --reject NAME         block a skill (removes an owned cache copy)
  --uninstall NAME      remove an owned cache copy + drop its lockfile entry
  --reset               remove ALL owned cache copies + clear the lockfile
  --status              show the installed / pending / blocked roster
  --status-line         read-only one-block roster for the session-start hook
  --harness-path HARNESS_PATH
                        execution-cache dir (default ~/.claude/skills)
  --force-shadow        allow approving a name that shadows a PACKAGE skill
  --force-conflict      allow approving over a FOREIGN (unowned) cache dir
